business_model.claim: Allstate mainly sells personal property-liability insurance (auto, homeowners and other personal lines) to consumers. The Allstate Protection segment accounts for 93.9% of consolidated insurance premiums and contract charges in the latest annual report.
quotes: The Allstate Corporation is one of the largest publicly held personal lines insurers in the United States.
Our Allstate Protection segment accounted for 93.9% of Allstate’s 2025 consolidated insurance premiums and contract charges

business_model.basis: stated in the 10-K segment table and the 10-Q MD&A
business_model.claim: Reporting segments are Allstate Protection, Run-off Property-Liability, Protection Services and Corporate. Underwriting income measures the two insurance segments, and adjusted net income measures Protection Services and Corporate.
quotes: The measure of segment profit or loss used in evaluating performance is underwriting income for the Allstate Protection and Run-off Property-Liability segments and adjusted net income for the Protection Services and Corporate segments.
Includes holding company activities and certain non-insurance operations

business_model.claim: Premiums are the dominant revenue line. In the nine months to September 30 (table in millions), total revenues were 52,885. Property and casualty insurance premiums and contract charges were 47,079, net investment income was 3,124 and other revenue was 2,171.

business_model.basis: stated in the 10-K Item 1 text; the link to cost lines is inferred from the cost line items in the 10-Q
business_model.claim: The company sells through three channels: exclusive agents, independent agents and direct. Exclusive agents are paid a base commission on eligible written premium plus variable pay and bonuses tied to growth and profitability. Distribution cost therefore scales with premium and with growth.
quotes: We serve our customers through three distribution channels: exclusive agency, independent agency and direct channels primarily under the Allstate and National General (including Direct Auto) brands.

Compensation includes a monthly base commission as a percentage of eligible written premium, variable pay for new customer acquisition and product bundling and monthly and annual bonuses based on profitable customer growth.

business_model.basis: stated in the earnings release and 10-Q MD&A
business_model.claim: Revenue growth is driven by policies in force and average premium. Auto and homeowners policies in force were 3.4% and 3.3% higher than a year earlier.
quotes: Auto and homeowners insurance policies were 3.4% and 3.3% higher than last year, respectively
primarily due to higher auto and homeowners insurance policies in force, homeowners insurance average premium, net investment income and valuation gains on equity investments

business_model.basis: stated in the earnings release tables; the mechanism is inferred from the MD&A language on policies in force and average premium
business_model.claim: Growth is uneven by line. In the third quarter, homeowners premiums earned rose 11.5% while auto premiums earned rose 0.6%.
Pricing depends on rate increases that regulators must approve. Regulatory approval of rates can restrict the changes needed to reach target profitability.
quotes: Regulatory approval of rates, especially during inflationary periods, may restrict rate changes that may be required to achieve targeted levels of profitability and returns on equity.

business_model.claim: Claims and claims expense is the largest cost. In the nine months (table in millions), property and casualty claims and claims expense was 28,990 against premiums of 47,079. Amortization of deferred policy acquisition costs was 6,600 and operating costs and expenses were 6,876.

business_model.basis: stated in the 10-Q MD&A, the earnings release and the 8-K
business_model.claim: Catastrophe losses are the main swing factor in the cost of claims. They were 1,650 in the third quarter against 558 a year earlier (table in millions). The Property-Liability combined ratio moved to 86.6 from 80.1.
quotes: Underwriting income decreased $800 million in the third quarter of 2026 compared to the third quarter of 2025, due to higher losses, primarily from catastrophes
Total catastrophe losses for the third quarter were $1.65 billion or $1.30 billion, after-tax.

business_model.basis: stated in the 10-Q table; the risk comes from the 10-K reserve risk factor
business_model.claim: Favourable prior-year reserve reestimates (releases) reduce reported claims costs. In the nine months (table in millions), prior year reserve reestimates were (2,398) against (1,045) a year earlier. Releases are shown in parentheses.
quotes: (1)Reserve releases are shown in parentheses.

business_model.claim: Claim severity is driven by inflation and repair, medical and legal costs. Management links severity to higher repair costs, total-loss mix, medical consumption and attorney representation. The latest 10-Q adds that higher oil prices and other macro factors could raise costs.
quotes: Estimated report year 2025 incurred claim severity for Allstate brand increased compared to report year 2024 for major coverages due to higher repair costs, mix of total loss frequency, medical consumption and attorney representation.
Increased oil prices may contribute to higher transportation, manufacturing and repair costs.

business_model.basis: stated in the 10-Q and the earnings release
business_model.claim: Net investment income is a second earnings source. It was 3,124 in the nine months against 2,557 a year earlier (table in millions). Market-based income was 2,515 and performance-based income was 801.
quotes: due to both higher market-based and performance-based investment results

business_model.basis: figures are stated in the 10-Q balance sheet; the float interpretation is inferred

business_model.basis: stated in the 10-K segment table and the earnings release

quotes: consumer product protection plans, roadside assistance, automotive protection and insurance products, identity protection and restoration

competitive_position.basis: stated in the annual report risk factors and the 10-Q risk-factor update

quotes: The personal property-liability market is highly competitive with carriers competing through underwriting, advertising, price, customer service, innovation and distribution.
Certain states impose or are contemplating regulatory limitations on the amount of profit that insurance companies may earn.

competitive_position.basis: stated in the annual report; the effect on growth is stated as a risk, not quantified

quotes: Catastrophe risk management actions have led us to reduce the size of the homeowners business in certain states, including customers with auto and other personal lines products, and may negatively impact future sales.

competitive_position.basis: stated in the 10-Q MD&A and annual report risk factors
competitive_position.claim: Macro and technology shifts are cited as risks. The annual report says autonomous vehicles and ride sharing could shrink the auto market, and auto is a significant portion of the business.
quotes: Increased oil prices may contribute to higher transportation, manufacturing and repair costs.

Since auto insurance constitutes a significant portion of the overall business, we may be more sensitive than other insurers and more adversely affected by trends that could decrease auto insurance rates or reduce demand for auto insurance over time.
